import math

\(2048, 11.4283, 8.3392, 8.7196, 65.6699, 13.2267, 10.0218\),
\(3072, 31.6220, 28.5074, 29.7808, 224.9290, 36.4569, 26.3684\),
\(4096, None, 80.8911, 82.0474, 524.9881, None, None\),
]

print\("=== Speedup: tiled_2d vs baseline ==="\)
for row in data:
    N = row[0]
    base = row[1]
    t2d = row[5]
    if base and t2d:
        print\(f"  N={N:4d}: baseline={base:.4f} ms, tiled_2d={t2d:.4f} ms, speedup={base/t2d:.2f}x"\)

print\("\\n=== Speedup: alignment_naive vs misaligned_b \(coalesced vs strided\) ==="\)
for row in data:
    N = row[0]
    naive = row[2]
    mis = row[4]
    if naive and mis:
        print\(f"  N={N:4d}: naive={naive:.4f} ms, misaligned={mis:.4f} ms, penalty={mis/naive:.1f}x"\)

print\("\\n=== O\(N^3\) scaling check: baseline time doubling ratio ==="\)
prev = None
for row in data:
    N = row[0]
    base = row[1]
    if base and prev:
        ratio_n = N / prev[0]
        ratio_t = base / prev[1]
        expected = ratio_n ** 3
        print\(f"  N {prev[0]}->{N} \({ratio_n:.1f}x\): time {ratio_t:.2f}x \(expected ~{expected:.1f}x for O\(N^3\)\)"\)
    if base:
        prev = \(N, base\)

print\("\\n=== tiled_2d vs alignment_naive at key sizes ==="\)

    naive = row[2]
    t2d = row[5]
    if naive and t2d:
        print\(f"  N={N:4d}: alignment_naive={naive:.4f} ms, tiled_2d={t2d:.4f} ms, speedup={naive/t2d:.2f}x"\)
